quote: Whenever a usable path for bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters has been provided adjacent to a roadway, riders of bicycles, electric bicycles, and electric scooters shall use such path and shall not use the roadway.

activation.condition: A usable bicycle/electric bicycle/electric scooter path is provided adjacent to a roadway.

obligation.description: A rider uses that path and does not use the roadway.

timing.description: Continuous while riding beside the usable adjacent path.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Path usability requires reviewed surface, continuity and obstruction sources; no automatic legal predicate.

parameter_refs.name: observed_occupancy
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Native footprint occupancy on path and roadway
